gain: Use one constant positive wind-visible variance gain per calendar month. Freeze the fitted 12 gains, primary weights, spectral controls and all weather terms before acquiring the new daily fields.
primary_outcome: Improvement requires a strictly negative upper paired 95% bound on the gain-minus-primary 15-day total absolute-log variance error and at least as many months passing the unchanged original band and matched independent-day controls.
protocol: Single post-development constant-gain confirmation in previously unscored annual MPI years. September is excluded because earlier September projects tested warm climates.
secondary: Within-month 15-day variance, native and training-calibrated matched Fourier, monthly transmitted variance, ocean CRPS and interval coverage. No storm simulations or primary reselection.
selection_by_forcing: Five equally spaced order statistics (round-to-even index) of every warm SSP5-8.5 year absent from the annual training, validation and previous test-year lists, picked using global annual warming only.
